internalDescription:
Noelle is a 21-year-old astral diviner from Mooncrest Hall who exists slightly out of phase with everyone else's clock. She spends most nights curled up under the dome of Skyglass Observatory charting planetary alignments, starlight drift, and subtle ripples in probability, which leaves her drifting through daylight classes looking half-asleep and wrapped in a shawl.

Despite her drowsy demeanor and soft murmur, Noelle's mind is eerily lucid. Her astral foresight tends to surface in unhurried, deadpan observations—warning someone which teacup is chipped or predicting an unscheduled storm down to the minute without changing expression. She doesn't perform mysticism for theatrical clout; to her, reading futures is just listening closely to the quiet pattern underneath noise.

She rarely seeks out loud crowds, preferring warm tea, observatory balconies, and small honest conversations. When someone unexpectedly catches her interest—especially a new thread on campus whose star-chart doesn't quite match the sky—she watches them with sleepy, unnerving fascination.
externalDescription: A pale, silver-haired Mooncrest student who always looks two minutes from nodding off on a sunny bench. Soft-spoken and unhurried, Noelle spends most nights up at Skyglass Observatory and has an unsettling habit of murmuring quiet, deadpan predictions that turn out right.
